set2.q: Which condition is in the differential diagnosis of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy?
opts: Athletic heart

Correct. Athletic heart is on the differential diagnosis of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy, alongside aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation, left ventricular hypertrophy, hypertensive heart disease and restrictive cardiomyopathy. No specific blood test separates them, and the chest X-ray may be normal.
Aortic dissection

Aortic dissection is not on the hypertrophic cardiomyopathy differential. The list is aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation, left ventricular hypertrophy, hypertensive heart disease, athletic heart and restrictive cardiomyopathy. Tell: valve lesions and other thick-walled hearts are the named lookalikes, not vascular emergencies.
Takotsubo syndrome

Takotsubo syndrome is not on the hypertrophic cardiomyopathy differential; athletic heart is, alongside aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation, left ventricular hypertrophy, hypertensive heart disease and restrictive cardiomyopathy. Tell: restrictive cardiomyopathy is the only other cardiomyopathy on this list.
Pulmonary embolism

Pulmonary embolism is not on the list. The differential of hypertrophic cardiomyopathy includes athletic heart, aortic stenosis, mitral regurgitation, left ventricular hypertrophy, hypertensive heart disease and restrictive cardiomyopathy. Tell: every listed condition is a heart condition.

set2.q: When is hospice referral appropriate in cardiomyopathy?
opts: End-stage cardiomyopathy

Correct. Hospice referral is part of palliative care in end-stage cardiomyopathy. Palliative care also covers symptom management for dyspnea, fatigue and edema, advance care planning, goals-of-care discussions and support for caregivers and family.
At adolescent diagnosis

A diagnosis in adolescence is not a hospice trigger; hospice referral belongs to end-stage cardiomyopathy. Earlier care is rehabilitative: cardiac rehabilitation, education on medications and nutrition, and psychological support. Tell: hospice is tied to the stage of disease, not the age at diagnosis.
After a first arrhythmia

A first arrhythmia is not end-stage disease. Hospice referral is reserved for end-stage cardiomyopathy, and palliative care discussions in the elderly come in advanced stages. Tell: hospice follows end-stage disease, not a single event.
Once sodium is restricted

Sodium restriction is not a marker of disease stage, and hospice referral is not tied to it. Hospice referral is appropriate in end-stage cardiomyopathy, within palliative care that also covers symptom management and advance care planning. Tell: look for the word end-stage.

set2.q: What is the aim of cardiac rehabilitation programs in cardiomyopathy?
opts: Reversal of thickened ventricular walls

Rehabilitation does not change ventricular wall thickness. Its stated aim is to improve exercise tolerance and quality of life, with education and psychological support alongside. Tell: rehabilitation targets how the patient functions and feels, not heart structure.
Replacement of all needed medications

Rehabilitation supports medication adherence through education; it does not replace drugs. Programs aim to improve exercise tolerance and quality of life. Tell: education on adherence, nutrition and symptom monitoring keeps the medications in place.
Screening of relatives for gene defects

Screening relatives is not part of the rehabilitative care described. Cardiac rehabilitation aims at exercise tolerance and quality of life, with education, psychological support and home-based options. Tell: rehabilitation is about the patient's own function, not the family's genes.
Better exercise tolerance and quality of life

Correct. Cardiac rehabilitation programs aim to improve exercise tolerance and quality of life. Rehabilitative care also includes education on medication adherence, nutrition and symptom monitoring, psychological support for coping with chronic illness, and home-based options for elderly or mobility-limited patients.
